links.targetTitle: Bringing USDS home in an emergency still requires a Sky Exec

title: Sweeping accrued Spark revenue into the ALM Proxy needs no token holder vote
content:
A.6.1.1.1.2.6.1.2.1.2.3 authorizes Phoenix Labs "to propose the inclusion of transfers of accrued treasury and collector revenues from the Active Instances to the Spark ALM Proxy in a Spark Spell." For "non-USD-denominated reserve assets, or USD-denominated reserve assets that are not supported by the Spark Liquidity Layer," the reserves may go to the Spark Operations Multisig "to be liquidated for USDS, with the proceeds of sale transferred to the Spark SubDAO Proxy." The request must be posted to the Sky Forum under Spark Prime, and "the Operational Executor Agent must formally approve the inclusion of the transfer in a Spark Spell, **with no token holder vote needed**."

This is a third write path, distinct from Root Edit governance and from Active Data edits: a standing authorization for a recurring treasury action, gated by an operational approver rather than an electorate.

The reasoning is that revenue sweeping is mechanical. The funds already belong to Spark, the destination is fixed, and the only judgment involved is whether the transfer is correctly constructed. Routing each sweep through a weekly poll would add delay and voter fatigue without adding a decision.

The liquidation clause is the part carrying real discretion. Selling exotic or unsupported reserve assets for USDS involves timing, venue and slippage choices made by the Spark Operations Multisig — the same multisig that serves as the Avalanche bridge Guardian — with no vote and no execution parameters specified here. Public posting to the Forum plus the Operational Executor Agent's formal approval are the only checks on that step.
description: Phoenix Labs proposes the transfer, unsupported or non-USD reserves route through the Spark Operations Multisig for liquidation into USDS, and the Operational Executor Agent approves it alone.
